info.description: ListenFree API provides a platform for fast, ad-free music streaming, allowing users to create smart playlists, enjoy collaborative listening rooms, and access video previews of songs. The API supports offline playback and prioritizes user privacy, making it a reliable choice for music enthusiasts.
